answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by charging a refundable bond for every identity. To register, an agent locks capital in a smart contract; an attacker who mints a thousand fake identities must lock a thousand separate deposits. A watchdog slashes any accounts that share device fingerprints or move in lockstep, so the attacker forfeits the bond faster than the scheme earns, and forgery loses money on net. The strongest operators reach the summit of the trust ladder while keeping their copper collateral safe, and each newcomer pays the same entry terrace before bidding on work.
